company_profile: Accenture is a global consulting firm that designs, builds and runs AI and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients.
title: AI/ML Computational Scientist
summary: AI/ML engineer with 8+ years designing machine learning and Generative AI solutions and deploying them in production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Builds scalable SQL and PySpark data pipelines, customises deep learning and LLM models through fine-tuning and LLM APIs, and runs MLOps with MLflow, Docker and Kubernetes on GCP and Azure. Works with clients to turn real problems into production outcomes. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

experience_edits.new: Deployed a production lab-extraction agent on the Claude Opus 4.7 API with Amazon Textract, integrated with LIMS, handling about 1,800 lab documents and automating the work behind 800 Jira tickets and PRD tasks.

experience_edits.new: Engineered scalable SQL and PySpark data pipelines on large healthcare datasets, automating BAU medical-audit reporting and cutting manual reporting effort by 95%.

project.name: Distributed Predictive Maintenance Pipeline
bullets: Built a distributed training and batch inference pipeline for predictive maintenance on industrial sensor data, running PySpark feature jobs and PyTorch models on Kubernetes with Airflow scheduling.
Evaluated models on held-out equipment histories, tracked runs and versions in MLflow, and served predictions through a Dockerised FastAPI service with drift monitoring and alerting.

paragraphs: I am applying for the AI/ML Computational Scientist Manager role at Accenture. Most of my eight-plus years have been spent in the space this role describes: taking a client's problem and data, choosing and adapting the model, and building the pipelines that keep it running in production.

Accenture puts AI into client systems where it has to earn its place, and that is how I have always worked, first in consulting and then in product teams. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Ireland together and settle there long term, so a role with a long runway there suits us.

At Viavi I prototyped 15+ AI applications from client requirements, and 7 of them moved into production or paid client work. At United Health Group I deployed a lab-extraction agent on the Claude API with Amazon Textract that handles about 1,800 documents, with evaluation and monitoring pipelines that cut human review by 43%.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Building it for teachers has taught me to scope carefully and ship what real users can rely on. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
